## Primary Technical Specializations
- **SoC & Processor Platforms**: Qualcomm QCM6125, Quectel SC668S Smart Module SOM, Rockchip SoCs, ARM Cortex, Raspberry Pi 4, STM32, Arduino, Xilinx FPGA (Nexys2 / Spartan), Nvidia Tegra.
- **Firmware, BSP & OS**: Linux Kernel bring-up, Board Support Package (BSP), Android Open Source Project (AOSP) customization, device drivers, FreeRTOS, OTA update engine (Full & Incremental), Perfetto tracing, GDB debugging.
- **Hardware & PCB Design**: Altium Designer, EasyEDA, High-Speed Flex & Rigid-Flex PCBs, Multilayer (6+ layer) impedance-controlled routing, 90Ω differential pairs, EMI/EMC shielding, RF Antenna tuning (2.4GHz & 5GHz), DFM (Design for Manufacturing).
- **Peripherals & Protocols**: MIPI DSI display, I2C capacitive touch controllers, LVDS LT9211D bridge, MIPI CSI camera modules, NFC PN7220 integration, UART, SPI, I2C, USB 2.0/3.0, CAN, PWM, ADC/DAC, Battery management & fast/reverse wireless charging ICs.
- **Mass Production & Factory Operations**: 4 on-site engineering missions to Shenzhen, China for high-volume SMT production runs (reflow profiling, X-ray inspection, AOI, BGA dye & pry testing, automated GMS key flashing/provisioning, FCC/CE/EMI/EMC compliance, thermal profiling with 8-probe monitoring, aging & burn-in testing).
- **Programming Languages**: Embedded C, C++, Python, Verilog HDL, Bash / Shell Scripting, ARM Assembly.

## Key Projects
- [AI Interactive Device (Quectel SC668S & QCM6125)](https://itstalmiz.com/#projects): End-to-end firmware development on Quectel Smart SOM; MIPI display/touch/camera bring-up, battery management ICs with reverse wireless charging, and high-speed multilayer flex PCB design.
- [Semi-Autonomous Tracking Sentry Robot](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7089844394522025984/): Raspberry Pi 4 onboard computer with OpenCV real-time target detection, pan-tilt servo tracking, wireless live telemetry, and custom power PCB.
- [Image Convolution on FPGA (Xilinx)](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7076157169204666368/): Real-time hardware-accelerated 2D convolution pipeline with Verilog ROM image streaming and VGA output display.
- [Line-Following, Sumo & Obstacle-Avoidance Robot](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:6890727805563604992/): Arduino multi-mode combat and autonomous robotics platform with custom PCB chassis and Bluetooth mobile control app.
- [Retinal Blood Vessel Segmentation Enhancement](https://itstalmiz.com/#projects): Implementation of 2D Frangi vesselness filter in MATLAB for biomedical image segmentation against clinical ground truth.
- [4-Digit Decimal Counter on Nexys2 FPGA](https://itstalmiz.com/#projects): Parameterized Verilog counter driving multiplexed 7-segment display with BCD converter and custom clock division.
- [IoT Plant Monitoring System](https://bit.ly/3rT93pv): NodeMCU ESP8266 IoT telemetry system with soil moisture, temp/humidity logging, and cloud-driven pump relay control.
- [Enterprise Dynamic Network Architecture](https://itstalmiz.com/#projects): VLSM subnetting, OSPF/RIPv2 routing, VLAN segmentation, and NAT overload gateway.
